# REMAINING WORK — Geelooy Revival Audit

The Awtsmoos renews the screen each instant; the vessel must become lucid, useful, and bright.
Awtsmoos.com should reveal one clear next action, not bury living function beneath decorative night.

## Mission

Audit the public routes represented by `geelooy`, use the existing route/runtime-quality machinery instead of rebuilding it, repair broken or cluttered surfaces only after real source/runtime tracing, and avoid overwriting concurrent agent work.

## Direct Evidence

- `geelooy` is the public/static source root; browser URLs omit the `geelooy` path segment.
- Earlier census found 228 HTML/page documents and already created modular CDP runtime-audit tooling under `scripts/runtime_quality/`.
- Current worktree is heavily dirty with multiple concurrent agents.
- Shema Strike, Ohrfront, Social Composer, Animator, Mitzvah World, and runtime-audit tooling have active modifications.
- `geelooy/mawgawl` is currently clean and is therefore the safest screenshot-owned surface for immediate reconstruction.
- Sefarim currently presents hero, guarantees, multi-mode controls, scope tabs, results, indexed lanes, history, and guidance simultaneously.
- User screenshots also show poor game affordance/visual hierarchy, a mostly blank Animator canvas, and a crowded Social Composer.

## Concurrency Guard

- [ ] Never reset, clean, stash, checkout, or discard unrelated work.
- [ ] Re-check scoped Git status immediately before each production write.
- [ ] Treat directories with active agent edits as audit-only until ownership becomes safe.
- [ ] Prefer clean route families for first implementation waves.

## Discovery Work

- [ ] Read all Sefarim HTML/CSS/JS owners that determine visible hierarchy.
- [ ] Trace Sefarim search modes, progressive disclosure, history, and result rendering.
- [ ] Run existing runtime audit against `/mawgawl/sefarim/` before mutation.
- [ ] Capture DOM metrics at desktop and mobile widths.
- [ ] Build representative route matrix across core, Torah, social, apps, games, editors, media, auth, docs, and OS surfaces.
- [ ] Run a bounded whole-surface crawl after the first safe route is repaired.
- [ ] Classify each finding as runtime failure, layout failure, interaction failure, accessibility failure, visual hierarchy debt, or intentional behavior.

## Sefarim Reconstruction Work

- [ ] Make search the unmistakable primary action.
- [ ] Collapse secondary search modes into progressive disclosure rather than permanent first-viewport weight.
- [ ] Reduce simultaneous side-rail competition.
- [ ] Keep results immediately adjacent to the query task.
- [ ] Preserve provenance, exact coordinates, persisted-index truth, and existing query parameters.
- [ ] Preserve keyboard, screen-reader, history, and API behavior.
- [ ] Make mobile layout one-column and touch-safe without horizontal overflow.
- [ ] Ensure empty, loading, error, and populated states each have a clear visual hierarchy.
- [ ] Keep every touched source file <=120 lines; split before rewriting a larger responsibility.
- [ ] Rewrite touched files completely with tabs where indentation exists.

## Wider Public-Surface Work

- [ ] Audit Shema Strike runtime and gameplay ergonomics without overwriting its active edits.
- [ ] Audit Ohrfront runtime/gameplay clarity without overwriting its active edits.
- [ ] Audit Animator blank-canvas/root-layout failure without overwriting its active edits.
- [ ] Audit Social Composer hierarchy after the active redesign agent finishes or ownership clears.
- [ ] Audit game index discoverability and every game entry route for load/runtime failures.
- [ ] Audit partially styled/native controls, viewport overflow, fixed/sticky collisions, and missing interaction states identified by the prior sitewide ledger.

## Verification Work

- [ ] Read back every touched file in full.
- [ ] Run syntax/source-architecture tests for touched JS modules.
- [ ] Run focused Sefarim tests and add missing regression contracts only after implementation.
- [ ] Browser-test query submission and each search mode.
- [ ] Browser-test 430px mobile, standard desktop, and short-height viewport.
- [ ] Confirm no site-owned console errors, failed static resources, MIME mismatches, or accidental overflow.
- [ ] Compare planned versus actual changes and write delta artifacts.
- [ ] Repeat implementation if any delta remains.

## NEXT_ACTION

Write the three mandatory planning waves grounded in this evidence, then inspect the remaining Sefarim owners and run the existing runtime gate before any production rewrite.
